definitions.gloss: the season leader in runs batted in
definitions.explanation: In baseball, the title given to the player who records the most runs batted in (RBIs) over a season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打点|だてん}{王|おう}だ。
examples.english: He is this year's RBI leader.

examples.japanese: {打点|だてん}{王|おう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。

⟦{四番|よんばん}→四番：30009_yonban⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦{打点|だてん}→打点：08589_daten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧{打点|だてん}{王|おう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The cleanup hitter surpassed 100 RBIs to claim the RBI title.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{打点|だてん}→打点：08589_daten⟧ (runs batted in, RBI) + ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ (king). The title awarded to the player with the most RBIs in a season.
